notes.title: A small but lovely Endless Mode Update. (Send your message to Alice-sama!)
notes.content:
[p]
[/p][h2]1. Endless Mode[/h2][p]Alice-sama came up with some new rules for Endless Mode.
Well, what did she do? 
She did her best! 🥰

Endless Mode is now available after Chapter 5.
Enjoy forever with Alice-sama.


[/p][h2]2. Send your message to Alice-sama![/h2][p]Alice-sama's Marshmallow inbox is now open! 
[url="https://marshmallow-qa.com/c74oc5ivra1e94b"]https://marshmallow-qa.com/c74oc5ivra1e94b[/url]
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45198079/10dfe40cd239fd7e5f84bd6dad4116640014116d.png"][/img][/p][p]
You can now send your message to Alice-sama! You can ask Alice-sama questions. Or you can send your messages if you need any advice, compliments, or any supportive words from Alice-sama. 💖

Alice-sama wants to know more about consciousness! Why do we have subjective experience?
If you manage to solve the Hard Problem of consciousness, please send your solution.

We understand that sending messages and hearing nothing back can be frustrating. Please forgive Alice-sama for not being able to respond to every message. 🥹

[/p][h2]3. Support our future work![/h2][p]Alice-sama said... We should ask for help when we need to...
So...
We need more support!!!!!

If you like Alice-sama. 
Please share this game with your friends! Thank you~~~~~ 😭
It's difficult to keep going for indie games developer.

If you think a friend would love this too, you can kindly gift them a copy. 💝
We truly appreciate your support! Your support helps our little game grow. Thank you... 

A new game is currently in active development.

The name of the game is not announced yet. The idea of the story is:
"A Metaphysical Visual Novel. A world without sadness."

This is a song from the original soundtrack of my next game! 🍃
Please have a listen!💚

[/p][previewyoutube="PUw5uMHWGUI;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube]
